incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sustained 5xx/429 spike on /v1/generate (eu-west-1-edge). 5-min error rate 14% (>5% threshold). Pager duty: Olivia paged. monitor: https://monitoring.redwood/internal/alerts/4061239876
Olivia: I'm on it, joining now. pulling edge logs and kvcache stats. 429s look concentrated on identical session tokens / high inflight concurrency per-token.
Raj: looking at netflow — inbound fanout from ~120 unique IPs, same ASNs. smells like scraper botnet replaying tokens. WAF sigs currently low-confidence. I'll start geo-slice + short-term quota adjustments for high-churn keys.
Maria: will tag suspect WAF ruleset as `suspicious-headless` and enable header-fingerprint block for common headless UA patterns. will keep tag for quick rollback.
Olivia: enacted a dynamic quota bump for customer_tier=enterprise: `PATCH /config/quota?scope=enterprise` increased concurrency_limit 20->60 for 30m. doing gradual rollout to avoid overload.
Sam: support seeing ~40 customers with transient 429s; prepping proactive comms to top-10 affected. Draft: "Applying temporary quota adjustment + mitigations; expect success rate improvement within 10-15m." ready to send once we confirm numbers.
Raj: pushed an edge rule canary in eu-west-1: `if (requests_per_min > 400 && ua contains 'Headless') { add_waf_tag('suspicious-headless'); challenge_or_block(15m); }` monitoring canary traffic now.
Olivia: initial effect: 429 rate down 14% -> 3.2% over last 5m, latency unchanged. keeping mitigations live for 30m while we investigate root ASNs. handing long-tail to @Raj and WAF tuning to @Maria.
Raj: will run IP->token correlation, build ASN blocklist for the worst offenders, and enable captcha challenge for suspect flows. enabling debug logging: `edge.waf.tag=suspicious-headless` for full audit.
Maria: rollback plan in place: remove `suspicious-headless` tag and revert enterprise quota if we see false positives. tagging incident id=4061239876 severity=high.
Nate: product note — no code/feature toggles needed. prefer avoid disabling embeddings/batch endpoints unless necessary.
Olivia: handing to night oncall @Tina for monitoring and customer follow-up. escalate to pgd if 429s >5% or more customers escalate. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: Oncall shift changed: Olivia -> Tina."
